newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Scientific Q1 oper shr lower.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Scientific Q1 oper shr lower.

text.p: Loss on Disposal of Solium Subsidiary(12,040,000) --
NOTE: Company posted $12 million charge, or $0.97 per share as part plant to phase out and seek a buyer for Solium subsidiary. Solium reclassified as discontinued operation.

Because of the reclassification, the 1997 first quarter and all prior periods are being restated to separately present continuing operations, Solium's past operations and the discontinuance charge. Solium operations in the current first quarter had an after tax loss of $1.5 million, or $0.13 per share, compared with a loss of $1.2 million, or $0.10 per share, in the prior year period.

Pacific Scientific sustained a net loss for the current first quarter of $10.8 million, or $0.88 per share. These results included income of $0.22 per share from continuing operations, a loss of $0.13 per share from Solium operations and a discontinuance charge of $0.97 per share. The Company does not presently expect any further charges relating to the Solium operation.

Included in the first quarter expenses from continuing operations was a charge of $264,000 to retire $5.6 million of industrial revenue bonds, representing a write-off of the remaining unamortized expenses involved in the issuance of the bonds. The bond proceeds are currently reported on the Company's balance sheet as "restricted cash" and classified as a long-term asset. This cash will be used to fund the retirement of the bonds and will reduce the Company's long term debt. The charge will not affect the Company's working capital ratio.

The decline in sales, along with the expense of retiring the bonds, were the principal factors contributing to the lower net income from continuing operations for the current first quarter versus the prior year.
